notes.title: New STORY UPDATE!
notes.notes: There is a [b]new part[/b] of the [b]lore [/b]that you can find in [b]Medium[/b] mode of Chapter 1!

notes.title: Discover the Story behind Mr. White!
notes.notes:
If you're curious about the [b]story [/b]of this game, you better start searching for [b]letters [/b]in Mr. White's house.
There is one [b]unique letter[/b] in every [b]DIFFICULTY[/b] of the game,[u] except the Practice mode[/u]. In this update, I added [b]only [/b]letters in [b]EASY[/b] mode. More [u]coming soon[/u]!

notes.title: Mr. White now knows how to place traps for his victims! Be careful.
